_comment: G-SHARE everyExportHasACaller (SPEC §10.1, FR20, FA6): every framework surface export has ≥1 caller across the MIGRATED forges' bundles (entry, lib, tests — testSupport/migratedForgeRoster.js) OR a WRITTEN JUSTIFICATION here. F3b (edfi migrated): the corpus is Ed-Fi's bundle; a member no migrated forge calls carries its justification below, each citing the SPEC §3.3 surface row that says why the export exists. F3c/F3d REMOVE a row when the migrating forge's bundle calls the member (a stale justification for a member that HAS a caller is refused by the gate).

justificationByMember.contracts.FORGE_DECLARATION_CONTRACT: frozen DATA read by injectStandardHooks' validator (SPEC §3.3 'contracts.*'); a forge declares against it, never calls it — G-DECL exercises it
justificationByMember.contracts.STANDARD_HOOK_CONTRACT: frozen DATA read by injectStandardHooks' validator (SPEC §3.3); G-HOOK exercises it
justificationByMember.contracts.MIGRATION_ALLOWANCE_REGISTRY: frozen DATA read by the framework's allowance evaluators (SPEC §7); a forge names ids in its declaration — G-COMPAT exercises it
justificationByMember.contracts.CONTRACT_GRAPH_KIT_SURFACE: frozen DATA — the kit's surface as data 'so a hook author and a test read the same truth' (SPEC §3.4); G-KIT exercises it
justificationByMember.contracts.MIGRATING_BUNDLE_LIST: frozen DATA read by the declaration validator (SPEC §7.1); G-COMPAT outsideTheFourRefused exercises it
justificationByMember.constants.EMBED_BATCH_SIZE: the ONE copy of the batch ceiling (D6, SPEC §3.3) consumed by embed.embedNodes inside forge(); a hook MUST NOT read it (G-SHARE forbids EMBED_BATCH_SIZE in a hook file)
justificationByMember.constants.CORE_VERSION: the root's coreVersion stamped by rootNode.build inside forge() (SPEC §4.3); a hook never stamps it — G-ROOT exercises it
justificationByMember.vocabulary.NODE_LABELS: frozen re-export of lib/vocabulary (SPEC §3.3 'so a forge author requires ONE module'); Ed-Fi's walk uses DME_ROLES/EDGE_TYPES only — the kit stamps the labels
justificationByMember.vocabulary.PROVENANCE_TIER: frozen re-export (SPEC §3.3); the kit stamps provenanceTier on every edge — a hook never does
justificationByMember.vocabulary.STRUCTURAL_PROPERTIES: frozen re-export (SPEC §3.3); the finalizer stamps depth/parentId/crossRefs — a hook never does
justificationByMember.provenance.verifySnapshotChecksums: 'the ONE module that serves forge time AND the validator's intake' — called BY THE FRAMEWORK in forge() step 2 (SPEC §3.3, §6.1); Ed-Fi's validator is not yet behind validatorFrom (F3b ruling 03:20 #4) — G-CHECKSUM exercises it
justificationByMember.provenance.deriveVersionStamp: 'Called BY THE FRAMEWORK in forge(); exported for tests' (SPEC §3.3 verbatim) — G-VERSION exercises it
justificationByMember.embed.embedNodes: called BY THE FRAMEWORK in forge() step 6 (SPEC §6.3); a hook MUST NOT define or call it (G-SHARE) — G-EMBED exercises it
justificationByMember.structural.classifyParentReferent: re-export 'CALLED BY THE FRAMEWORK at the end of the pure layer; exported for fixture tests' (SPEC §3.3 verbatim) — G-REFERENT exercises it
justificationByMember.sequence.finalizeSequence: re-export called BY THE FRAMEWORK when a walk returns sequenceGroups (SPEC §6.2 step 5) — SIF's (F3c); Ed-Fi returns none — G-FINALIZERS exercises it
justificationByMember.searchText.buildSearchText: re-export 'so a validator or test composes the same text the forge did' (SPEC §3.3); Ed-Fi's validator predates the framework and is not migrated in F3b (ruling 03:20 #4); a hook MUST NOT call it (G-SHARE)
justificationByMember.refuse.byName: the house refusal shape (SPEC §3.3) every framework refusal is built with; exported for hook authors — Ed-Fi's walk keeps its own `throw new Error('forge-edfi REFUSED: …')` texts byte-for-byte for its pinned test regexes
justificationByMember.refuse.requiredKeys: pure helper exported for hook authors (SPEC §3.3); Ed-Fi's walk has no polymorphic input to apply it to
justificationByMember.refuse.closedValue: pure helper exported for hook authors (SPEC §3.3); Ed-Fi's registries refuse an unknown constructType/propertyType with their own named messages, pinned by its tests
justificationByMember.census.complianceReport: called BY THE FRAMEWORK at buildContractGraph step 7 (SPEC §6.2); returned to the seam as complianceReport — G-COMPAT exercises it
justificationByMember.roster.assertUniqueStandardNames: the G-UNIQUE gate helper (SPEC §3.3, RULING 00:15 gate 9) — a gate reads the roster; no forge does
